body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung presented ''SGH-i320N'' a smart phone with QWERTY keyboard and Window mobile 5.0 Smart phone version. It supports GSM/GPRS/EDGE(900/1800/1900MHz) and other features include a 2.2-inch QVGA display, a 1.3M camera, push email, a file viewer, Bluetooth connectivity and etc.
